import collections
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    asym={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=g[i][w-1-j] or g[i][j]!=g[h-1-i][j]}
    # intruder color: asymmetric cells' colors; pick color whose cells are all asymmetric and minority? use: color C minimizing count among colors in asym
    acol=collections.Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in asym)
    # candidate intruder color: the color c in acol with min total count
    C=min(acol,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    o=[r[:] for r in g]

def load2():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G: G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load2()
inp,out,ti=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output'],G['Test input']
for name,g in [('demo-in',inp),('demo-out',out),('test',ti)]:
    tr=[list(r) for r in zip(*g)]
    bad=[(i,j) for i in range(24) for j in range(24) if g[i][j]!=tr[i][j]]
    print(name,'transpose mismatches:',len(bad), bad[:12])

But careful: prefer the one consistent with all symmetries. Better: iteratively fill: repeat until stable: for each unknown cell (2), if any symmetric partner (under hm, vm, transpose, anti-diag, 180) has known non-2 value, set it.
